d: The inside of the Osteria della Garrettiera is a table, a large high chair, a bench. On the table the remains of a large desinare, several bottles and a glass. Calamaio, pens, paper, a candle lit. A broom leaning against the wall. I go out at the bottom, leads to the left. Falstaff is busy heating the wax of two letters to the flame of the candle, then seal them with a ring. After having sealed them, turn off the light and sits down comfortably on the high chair. Falstaff, Dr. Cajus, Bardolfo, Gun, the Oste in the bottom.
Garden. Left of Ford's house. Tree groups in the center of the scene. Alice, Nannetta, Meg, Mrs. Quickly, then Mr. Ford, Fenton, Dr. Cajus, Bardolfo, Gun.

The inside of the Osteria della Garteriera is as in the first act. Falstaff always laid in his great high chair at his usual place drinking his Xeres. Bardolfo and Gun towards the bottom next to the left door. Then Mrs. Quickly.

A room in Ford's house. Large window in the bottom. Door to the right, door to the left and another door to the right corner in the bottom that exits on the staircase. Another staircase in the corner of the bottom to the left. From the large open window you can see the garden. A closed screen is leaning on the left wall, next to a large fireplace. Wardrobe leaning on the right wall. A coffee table, a chest. Along the walls, a high chair and some scrambles. On the high chair, a lute. On the table, flowers. Alice, Meg, then Quickly from the door to the right laughing. Then Nannetta.
A square. On the right the outside of the "Osteria della Garrettiera" with the sign and the motto: "Honny soit qui mal y pense" . A bench next to the door. It's sunset time. Falstaff, then the Host.

The park of Windsor. In the center, the great oak of Herne. In the bottom, the embankment of a ditch. Extremely thick. Shrubs in bloom. It is night. You hear the distant appeals of the guard-woods. The park will gradually risk with the rays of the moon. Fenton, then Nannetta dressed as queen of fairies. Alice, not masked carrying on her arm a hood and in her hand a mask. Mrs. Quickly in great headphone and gray befana coat, a stick and a nasty slap of mask in her hand. Then Meg dressed with veils and masked.
